title: Feedback and status
intro: How the interface responds to the user: in-page alerts, temporary toasts, task status and loading.

accent.title: New feature
accent.body: You can now export the care plan as a PDF.

success.title: Plan published
success.body: The patient is now receiving reminders in the app.

warning.title: Overdue dose
warning.body: The 08:00 medication hasn't been logged yet.

danger.title: Sync failed
danger.body: Check your connection and try again.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Quick confirmations that disappear on their own. They appear at the bottom of the screen.

info.title: Info
info.body: The report will be sent by email.

status.title: Task status
status.description: StatusPill: color + icon + text, never color alone.

loading.title: Loading
loading.description: Skeleton when the content's shape is known; spinner for short actions.
loading.label: Loading patients…

guidelines.do1: Use a toast to confirm actions; an alert for situations that need attention.
guidelines.do2: Keep text short and say what happened.
guidelines.dont1: Don't use a toast for errors that require user action.
guidelines.dont2: Don't show a spinner for more than a few seconds without explanation.
